beats.say: Roman Reigns plays Akuma in the new Street Fighter movie.
And Cody Rhodes is Guile. The film hit US cinemas on Friday 16 October, and it's set in 1993.
Andrew Koji plays Ryu, Noah Centineo is Ken, and Callina Liang is Chun-Li.
But the wildest casting is still to come.
Even Jason Momoa and 50 Cent are in the cast.
It's directed by Kitao Sakurai, and made by Legendary and Capcom.
Who's the best casting choice here?
